svg.title: Three products on one identity platform
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Sign-in: Verify, adaptive, passwordless multifactor authentication for human and non-human identities. Governance: Verify Identity Governance provisions, audits and reports on access, with SoD controls, including for SAP. Protection: Verify Identity Protection finds shadow assets, unauthorized local accounts and missing MFA.
